info.title: EventSpot API Documentation
info.description: API Documentation for EventSpot, a platform to discover and manage events.

post.description: Logs in a user and returns an API token.

message.example: Votre adresse e-mail n'a pas encore été vérifiée.

post.description: Logs out the current authenticated user by revoking the token.
Send a new email verification link to the authenticated user if their email is not already verified. Redirects to dashboard if already verified.

302.description: Redirect to dashboard if email already verified

post.description: Reset the user's password using a valid token, email, and new password.
Verify a user's email address by submitting a valid OTP code.

message.example: Email address successfully verified via OTP.

post.description: Send a password reset link to the user's email address.

status.example: We have emailed your password reset link!

items.example: The email must be a valid email address.

post.description: Create a new user account with role-specific data and send an email verification notification.

interets.description: Array of interest IDs, required if role is 'public'

message.example: Registration successful. Please verify your email address.

get.description: Verify the user's email using the user ID and hash. Redirects to frontend login page with verification status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user to verify

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA1 hash of the user's email

302.description: Redirect to frontend login with verification status

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Set to true to get all categories without pagination

post.description: Creates a new category. Note: This route should be protected by authentication & authorization middleware.

description.example: Events related to music and concerts

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id

get.description: Returns list of events with filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search keyword for event title or description

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Filter by category ID

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Filter by creator user ID

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by event status

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Get the latest events

parameters.description: Number of latest events to return (used with 'latest')

parameters.description: Number of events per page for pagination

post.description: Creates a new event, its associated tickets, and uploads a media file. Requires organizer privileges.

description.example: A description of the awesome concert.

category_ids[].description: Array of category IDs to associate with the event.

url.description: Event banner image or video (jpg, jpeg, png, mp4). Max 10MB.

message.example: Événement et billets créés avec succès

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Event id

get.description: Returns a list of events that the authenticated user has favorited.

get.summary: Check if an event is favorited by the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the favorite status of a specific event for the logged-in user.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: ID of the event to check favorite status

post.summary: Toggle favorite status for an event
post.description: Add or remove an event from the authenticated user's favorites.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: ID of the event to toggle favorite

get.description: Retrieve the complete list of all available interests.

get.summary: Get active subscribers of an event
get.description: Retrieve the list of users subscribed (with active subscription) to a specific event. Only the event organizer can access this endpoint.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: ID of the event to get subscribers for

403.description: Forbidden - Only the event organizer can view subscribers

message.example: Access denied. Only the organizer can view subscribers.

get.summary: Check subscription status for an event
get.description: Returns whether the authenticated user's subscription to a specific event is active or not.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: ID of the event to check subscription status

message.example: Your subscription to this event is active.

post.summary: Toggle subscription status for an event
post.description: Activate, deactivate, or create a subscription for the authenticated user on a specific event.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: ID of the event to toggle subscription

get.summary: Get paginated tickets for events created by the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of tickets related to events created by the authenticated user.

get.summary: Search users by name or email
get.description: Search for users whose name or email contains the specified string (case-insensitive). Returns paginated results.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name or email substring to search for

200.description: Users found and returned in paginated format

404.description: No users found matching the search criteria

get.description: Retrieve detailed information of a user including their interests.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user to retrieve

get.summary: Get organizer dashboard statistics and data
get.description: Retrieve statistics, recent events, and tickets for the authenticated organizer user.

403.description: Forbidden - User is not an organizer or not authenticated

get.summary: Get organizer's events with optional filtering and search
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of events created by the authenticated organizer, optionally filtered by upcoming or past events and searchable by title or description.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter events by status: 'all' (default), 'upcoming', or 'past'

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter events by title or description

200.description: Paginated list of events retrieved successfully
